instruction: A candid medium shot captures an elegant indoor room with cream walls, patterned wallpaper, and a framed painting on the left. On the left side of the frame, the man with short hair in a dark blue suit (R1) stands in profile facing right, speaking. On the right side, the bald man with glasses in a blue suit (R2) stands in profile facing left, listening. The two men clasp right hands in a handshake, looking directly at each other during their conversation. Warm indoor lighting from an unseen source casts soft shadows, highlighting the rich blue suits and the cream background.
